note: WP-10 (E13): personality profiles for the gesture planner (dbe/gestures.py). A character's profile comes from the film (script.json speakers.<id>.profile), else its puppet (acting.profile), else its cast entry (profile), else 'neutral' (the planner's earlier gesture choices). tempo: speed of its gestures; energy: size (weight and gain) of beats; beat_gap: least seconds between gestures; beat_words: at most one beat per this many words; point: point | glance (look toward, no arm) | none; exclaim: the clip on an exclamation's strongest word (none: a beat); question: the clip at a question's end; listen_nod: weight of the nod after another's line (0: none); look_away: how far down and off the speaker its eyes drift while listening (0 to 1); never: clips this character never plays, even when tagged; react: the clip it plays during a gag's stare.

shy.about: small, rare gestures; looks down while listening; never points or celebrates
shy.question: think

excitable.about: big, frequent gestures, quick; celebrates exclamations; nods hard
excitable.question: shrug

calm.about: few, slow, open gestures; steady eye contact
calm.question: talk_open_palms

grumpy.about: crossed arms on questions, stomps on exclamations, barely nods
grumpy.question: cross_arms

thoughtful.about: thinks before answering, scratches the head on questions, moderate gestures
thoughtful.question: scratch_head

semantic.note: gesture names an agent may tag on a word, and the clip each means per template
